units.source_text: 薰大将听了仲信的报告，沉思前事，不胜悲伤。

en.t: General Kaoru listened to Nakanobu's report, reflected on what had happened before, and was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 他想：“宇治真是一个可恶的地方！

en.t: He thought, "Uji truly is a hateful place!

units.source_text: 我为什么叫浮舟住在这种地方呢？

en.t: Why did I make Ukifune live in such a place?

units.source_text: 最近发生这桩意外之事，也是由于我把她放在那里认为可以安心，因而别人就去侵犯了。”

en.t: This recent unexpected calamity happened because I left her there, thinking she would be safe, and so someone else went and violated her."

units.source_text: 他深悔自己疏忽大意，不通世故，胸中不胜悲痛。

en.t: He bitterly regretted his own carelessness and lack of worldly sense, and his heart could hardly bear the grief.

units.source_text: 母夫人正在患病，他在这里悲痛这种不吉之事，甚不相宜，便下山返京。

en.t: Since his mother was ill, it was deeply improper for him to mourn such an ill-omened matter there, so he went down from the mountain and returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 但他并不进入二公主房中，而是叫人传言：“有一个和我接近的人遭逢不幸。

en.t: But he did not enter the Second Princess's rooms, and instead had someone send word: "A person close to me has met with misfortune.

units.source_text: 虽无重大关系，我心不免悲伤。

en.t: Although the connection was not a grave one, my heart cannot help feeling sorrow.
I greatly fear the ill omen, so for the time being I will not enter your rooms."

units.source_text: 就独自在室中悲叹人世无常之苦。

en.t: Then he stayed alone in his room, lamenting the suffering caused by the impermanence of human life.

units.source_text: 回想浮舟生前容姿，实在非常姣美可爱，更增悲伤恋慕之情。

en.t: When he recalled Ukifune's appearance while she was alive, so truly beautiful and lovely, his grief and longing only grew stronger.

units.source_text: 他想：“她在世之日，我为什么不热诚地爱她，而空过岁月呢？

en.t: He thought, "While she was alive, why did I not love her with true devotion, but instead let the days pass in vain?

units.source_text: 如今回想起来，百思不能自解，后悔将无已时。

en.t: Now, looking back on it, no matter how much I think, I cannot explain it to myself, and my regret will never end.

units.source_text: 在恋爱的事上，我是命里注定要遭受痛苦的。

en.t: In matters of love, I seem fated to suffer pain.

units.source_text: 我本来立志异于众人，常思出家为僧。

en.t: From the beginning I had set my heart apart from others and often thought of leaving the world to become a monk.

units.source_text: 岂知事出意外，一直随俗沉浮，大约因此而受佛菩萨之谴责吧？

en.t: Who could have known that matters would turn out unexpectedly, and that I would keep drifting with worldly ways? Perhaps this is why I have received the rebuke of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

units.source_text: 也许是佛菩萨为欲使人起求道之心，行了个方便办法：隐去慈悲之色，故意叫人受苦。”

en.t: Perhaps the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, wishing to awaken in people the heart that seeks the Way, have used a skillful means: hiding the face of compassion and deliberately making people suffer."
Thereupon he devoted himself wholeheartedly to practicing the Buddhist Way.
